evidence.title: Crop Rotation An Approach To Secure Future Food by Samiha Ouda, Abd El-Hafeez Zohry, Tahany Noreldin
key_points: Crop rotation improves soil structure and nutrient content while maintaining sustainability.
It increases land productivity compared to monoculture.
Scheduling irrigation based on climate variability can maximize water usage.

evidence.title: Assessing crop rotation as a climate-smart agriculture ...
key_points: Maize following soybean on sandy soils yields best results.
Rainfall timing, not just totals, drives yield; rotations should align with rainfall patterns.
Organic amendments and cover crops can buffer erratic rainfall.

evidence.title: Utilizing Different Crop Rotation Systems for Agricultural and Environmental Sustainability: A Review
key_points: Legume inclusion boosts soil organic matter and carbon up to 18%.
Legumes improve phosphorus availability and soil structure.
Crop rotation enhances soil health and biodiversity.

evidence.title: Chapter 4 - Sustainable crop rotations
key_points: Egypt commonly uses a 3-year rotation of cotton, maize, rice.
Rotations vary by rainfall; low rainfall areas use more fallow.
Typical crop sequences in Egypt are documented.

evidence.title: Crop yield and water use efficiency in response to long-term diversified crop rotations
key_points: Diverse crop rotations increase soil water content across layers.
Certain sequences (PWFW) retain more water than monoculture.
Higher pre-planting soil moisture can benefit subsequent crops.

evidence.title: Crop Rotation: A Sustainable Practice for Soil and Water Conservation - Agriculture Notes by Agriculture.Institute
key_points: Cover crops and crop residues build organic matter, enhancing water retention.
Legume rotations reduce need for synthetic nitrogen and lower GHG emissions.
Water-limited environments benefit from rotations that complement water use patterns.

evidence_gaps: Exact water requirement per crop for the farm's soil type
Detailed irrigation scheduling for maize under current climate
Specific crop rotation sequences tested on sandy loam in Egypt
Yield outcomes for maize following different rotations in this region
Soil salinity impact on crop rotation choices
